turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mr. Patil, it is Rohan here. How are you doing today?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, Rohan beta. I am fine, just resting. You are calling after a long time.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, sorry about that. I was actually thinking about the Diwali holidays and if you are coming to visit us.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I want to come, but my knee is bothering me again. The doctor said I should avoid long travel.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is a shame. Maybe we can just come to Nagpur and spend the festival with you instead.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That would be very nice. But will you be able to manage the travel with the kids?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course we will. By the way, I remember you mentioned the house renovation last month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, the painting is almost done. It took a bit more time than I thought.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I saw the photos you sent. The new color looks very elegant.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you. It cost me about fifty thousand rupees more than the budget, but it was worth it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It definitely looks premium. We will see it in person when we visit next month.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will wait for you all. Take care of yourself and give my love to everyone.
